stop_policy: Observe first wake then stop only its local owned call; this is wake/rearm measurement. Full immediate-request/reply/quiet acceptance remains the separate acoustic_voice_smoke. Playback may end at detection,not a continuous-negative exposure estimate.
latency_limits: Estimated TTS keyword end plus afplay launch and HTTP observation interval; no sample-exact acoustic/model delay claim.
acceptance: Retain all missed controls and early/ambiguous events. No model or threshold tuning; no parity conclusion from reused synthetic sources. No independent continuous-negative exposure bound.

source_selection.prior_observation: Five-voice standalone pilot retained separately. This expansion was chosen to measure all existing variant0 phrasing and ordinary-sentence coverage, not select thresholds or remove difficult sources.
